description: This file defines the 'Decoder' class responsible for decoding key data (such as 'DEL', 'ENT', 'SPA', or text input) and applying corresponding input events or text to an Android InputConnection.

classes.name: Decoder
classes.description: A class that decodes string data representing key events or text and performs actions using an InputConnection to emulate key presses or insert text.

methods.name: decodeAndApply
methods.description: Decodes a string command and applies the corresponding key event or text insertion through the InputConnection.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the InputConnection has any text before or after the cursor, returning true if both are empty.
